Chinese food

How to cook it?

Ingredients: Half a chicken

Potatoes

Seasonings: Ginger

Garlic

Star anise

Spring onions

Green onions

Brown sugar

Sauce: Oyster sauce

Soy sauce

Dark soy sauce

Cornstarch solution

First, cut the chicken into pieces, wash thoroughly, and drain. Add salt, pepper, sesame oil, and cooking wine. Set aside to marinate for 1 hour.

Peel the potatoes and cut them into large pieces (soak in water).

Crush 2 cloves of garlic and slice 2 pieces of ginger.

Boil the chicken briefly.

Heat the oil, add the garlic, ginger, and star anise. Sauté until fragrant.  💥Add the chicken and add enough water.

💥After 5 minutes, add the potatoes, then add 2 tablespoons of oyster sauce, half a tablespoon of soy sauce, and brown sugar and dark soy sauce.

💥Cook for about 10 minutes, then add the spring onions.

💥Check the seasoning, then add the cornstarch solution and it's ready to serve.

Thank you. Happy cooking, guys and potatoes in Chinese style soy sauce","post_message_body":{"text":"Chinese food

How to cook it?

Ingredients: Half a chicken

Potatoes

Seasonings: Ginger

Garlic

Star anise

Spring onions

Green onions

Brown sugar

Sauce: Oyster sauce

Soy sauce

Dark soy sauce

Cornstarch solution

First, cut the chicken into pieces, wash thoroughly, and drain. Add salt, pepper, sesame oil, and cooking wine. Set aside to marinate for 1 hour.

Peel the potatoes and cut them into large pieces (soak in water).

Crush 2 cloves of garlic and slice 2 pieces of ginger.

Boil the chicken briefly.

Heat the oil, add the garlic, ginger, and star anise. Sauté until fragrant.  💥Add the chicken and add enough water.

💥After 5 minutes, add the potatoes, then add 2 tablespoons of oyster sauce, half a tablespoon of soy sauce, and brown sugar and dark soy sauce.

💥Cook for about 10 minutes, then add the spring onions.

💥Check the seasoning, then add the cornstarch solution and it's ready to serve.

Thank you. Happy cooking, guys
